rules.ask: {n} messages. Scrolling back gets slow. Add an index pane?
{n} decisions so far. Add a reasoning map?
{n} tasks have come up. Track them on a board?

afterNo: ask again when the count has doubled
_notes: Edit by hand; the controller reads this file on every turn.
decisions and tasks count proposed and confirmed items, not rejected ones.

fadeAfterTurns: a pane nobody touched for that many turns (messages you sent) fades to a tab; askRemoveAfterTurns: after that many more turns as a tab the controller asks once whether to remove it. Both can also be set per rule; leave one out to switch it off. The chat never fades, and a pane holding an unanswered proposal never fades.
